raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm, `GroupCoordinator.fused_allreduce_rmsnorm` uses AITER's 1-stage fused AR+RMSNorm kernel only up to a 128 KiB payload, a cutoff that only fits TP=8; this PR bounds the kernel's read volume (`payload × world_size`) and token count instead, so TP=2/4 decode batches get the faster 1-stage kernel.

Each 1-stage rank reads every peer's full payload, so cost grows with `world_size × payload`; at bf16, hidden 6144, the fixed cutoff is hit at 10 tokens.

## Modifications

- Select 1-stage when `token_num <= 80` and `payload * world_size <= 8 * 128 KiB`. The budget is today's TP=8 cutoff and where 1-stage stops winning at TP=4. 80 is the 1-stage grid size (`kMaxBlocks`); the cap only binds when `hidden × world_size ≤ 6472` (bf16).
- TP=8 is unchanged. At hidden 6144, batches of 11–42 tokens (TP=2) and 11–21 tokens (TP=4) move to 1-stage.
- `SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE` still overrides; `fused_allreduce_rmsnorm_quant_per_group` keeps its own rule (#24651).
- `test_aiter_allreduce_fusion_amd.py`: `TestFusedArRmsStageSelection` (CPU) pins the selection at TP=2/4/8, the token cap and the env override.

AITER's own `CudaCommunicator` already scales this cutoff with world size (ROCm/aiter#3745); SGLang calls `custom_fused_ar_rms` directly, with a lower budget (1 MiB of reads, not 1.75 MiB). GLM-5.x enables the fusion for decode by default on ROCm; other models reach it at TP=2/4 with `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion`.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K 5-shot, greedy, 1319 items, `lm_eval`, `num_concurrent=16` (decode batches in the new window), strict-match. 8× MI355X, main `0072e2cc08` on sglang build `0.5.21.dev20261002+gedee4308bc`, amd-aiter `0.1.23.dev183`.

| model | TP | main | PR |
|---|---:|---|---|
| GLM-5.3 (FP8) | 4 | 0.9271 (0.9189–0.9310, 5 runs) | 0.9253 (0.9212–0.9287, 5 runs) |
| Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4 (control, same kernel) | 8 | 0.8355 / 0.8415 | 0.8393 |

- GLM-5.3: every PR run is inside main's range; per-sample verdict agreement is 95.1–96.7 % main vs. PR and 95.5–96.5 % main vs. main.
- Same inputs through both kernels (TP=4, hidden 6144, m = 8–20): residual is bit-identical; normed output differs in ~6 per million elements by 1 bf16 ulp.
- Test file on 2× MI355X (main `b960aa903a`, amd-aiter `0.1.26.dev144`): 15 passed, 1 skipped (8-GPU benchmark); the new selection tests fail on main.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same build, torch `2.11.0+rocm10.0.0`. Arms run in blocks of 4, first run discarded, two blocks in opposite order; e2e uses a fresh server per run.

Micro, `benchmark_fused_ar_rms_amd.py`, graph-mode p50, block-minimum gain per shape:

| TP | switched shapes | median gain | range | unchanged |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 13 | **+17.2 %** | +13.7 … +23.2 % | −0.1 % ¹ |
| 4 | 14 | **+5.7 %** | +0.8 … +14.6 % | −0.5 … +0.1 % |
| 8 | 0 | — | — | −1.6 … +0.6 % |

¹ 131 × 6144; 3 × 6144 (8 µs) reads −2.3 % / +0.5 % across blocks.

At TP=4 the gain falls to +0.8 … +2.8 % at the edge of the read budget. At TP=2, with `use_1stage` forced, 1-stage is faster at every size measured (+15.6 % at 43 × 6144, +8.1 % at 81 × 2048, +7.8 % at 1024 × 7168), so the bounds are conservative.

e2e, GLM-5.3 TP=4, `sglang.benchmark.serving` random 1031/509, median of 6 warm runs:

| metric | c15 main → PR | c11 main → PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Total tok/s | 1848.8 → 1866.3 (+0.95 %) | 1495.8 → 1521.4 (+1.71 %) |
| Mean TPOT (ms) | 23.30 → 23.08 (−0.91 %) | 21.29 → 20.93 (−1.69 %) |

Median TPOT −1.04 % / −1.56 %; TTFT −2.05 … +0.45 %, within spread. Only graph bs 12 and 16 switch kernel; 156 fused calls per decode step × 0.7–1.5 µs is 0.1–0.23 ms per step, consistent with TPOT. Controls Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 TP=4 (path not called) and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B MXFP4 TP=8 (same kernel) move −0.70 … +1.51 % on every metric, within spread.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -100,6 +100,12 @@
 # creation so runtime collectives do not silently fall back to backend defaults.
 _MODEL_PARALLEL_GROUP_TIMEOUT: Optional[timedelta] = None
 
+# AITER fused AR+RMSNorm 1-stage kernel: one block per token up to kMaxBlocks,
+# and every rank reads every peer, so its read volume is payload * world_size
+# (128 KiB of payload at world_size 8).
+_FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_TOKENS = 80
+_FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_READ_BYTES = 8 * 128 * 1024
+
 
 def get_torch_distributed_pg_options(group_name=None):
     if not _is_npu:
@@ -850,17 +856,16 @@ def fused_allreduce_rmsnorm(
         if not hasattr(ca_comm, "custom_fused_ar_rms"):
             return None
 
-        # 1-stage vs 2-stage selection for fused AR+RMSNorm:
-        # The 1-stage kernel launches one block per token and is capped at
-        # 80 tokens (kMaxBlocks).  Guard with a byte threshold so large
-        # prefill batches fall through to the 2-stage kernel instead of
-        # hitting a runtime error.  AITER's C++ dispatch already gates
-        # which hidden_dims have valid 1-stage support.
+        # AITER's C++ dispatch further limits 1-stage to the hidden_dims it supports.
         if envs.SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.is_set():
             use_1stage_ar = envs.SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.get()
         else:
             total_bytes = input_.numel() * input_.element_size()
-            use_1stage_ar = total_bytes <= 128 * 1024
+            token_num = input_.numel() // input_.shape[-1]
+            use_1stage_ar = (
+                token_num <= _FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_TOKENS
+                and total_bytes * self.world_size <= _FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_READ_BYTES
+            )
 
         if (
             getattr(ca_comm, "_IS_CAPTURING", False)

@@ -10,6 +10,8 @@
 
 import torch
 
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import GroupCoordinator
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary import UnreducedOutput
 from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.fusions.allreduce import fused_attn_input
 from sglang.srt.layers.moe import utils as moe_utils
@@ -46,6 +48,8 @@ def _run_residual_accuracy_check():
         tensor_model_parallel_fused_allreduce_rmsnorm,
     )
     from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import (
+        _FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_READ_BYTES,
+        _FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_TOKENS,
         destroy_distributed_environment,
         destroy_model_parallel,
         init_distributed_environment,
@@ -130,7 +134,12 @@ def _run_residual_accuracy_check():
         frac_nonzero = (diff > 0).float().mean().item()
 
         nbytes = m * n * dtype.itemsize
-        stage = "1-stage" if nbytes <= 128 * 1024 else "2-stage"
+        stage = (
+            "1-stage"
+            if m <= _FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_TOKENS
+            and nbytes * world_size <= _FUSED_AR_RMS_1STAGE_MAX_READ_BYTES
+            else "2-stage"
+        )
         passed = max_diff <= ATOL
 
         if not passed:
@@ -493,6 +502,45 @@ def test_no_phase_opt_out_fuses_everywhere(self):
                 )
 
 
+class TestFusedArRmsStageSelection(CustomTestCase):
+    """1-stage vs 2-stage choice for the aiter fused AR+RMSNorm, on CPU tensors."""
+
+    def _selects_1stage(self, m, n, world_size):
+        ca_comm = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            disabled=False, custom_fused_ar_rms=MagicMock(return_value=None)
+        )
+        group = types.SimpleNamespace(ca_comm=ca_comm, world_size=world_size)
+        x = torch.empty(m, n, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        GroupCoordinator.fused_allreduce_rmsnorm(group, x, x, x[0], 1e-6)
+        return ca_comm.custom_fused_ar_rms.call_args.args[4]
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        patcher = patch.dict(os.environ)
+        patcher.start()
+        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
+        envs.SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.clear()
+
+    def test_read_budget_scales_with_world_size(self):
+        # 13 x 6144 bf16 is 156 KiB of payload.
+        self.assertTrue(self._selects_1stage(13, 6144, world_size=2))
+        self.assertTrue(self._selects_1stage(13, 6144, world_size=4))
+        self.assertFalse(self._selects_1stage(13, 6144, world_size=8))
+
+    def test_world_size_8_keeps_128_kib_payload(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._selects_1stage(8, 8192, world_size=8))
+        self.assertFalse(self._selects_1stage(9, 8192, world_size=8))
+
+    def test_token_cap(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self._selects_1stage(80, 2048, world_size=2))
+        self.assertFalse(self._selects_1stage(81, 2048, world_size=2))
+
+    def test_env_overrides_selection(self):
+        with envs.SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.override(True):
+            self.assertTrue(self._selects_1stage(131, 6144, world_size=8))
+        with envs.SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.override(False):
+            self.assertFalse(self._selects_1stage(1, 6144, world_size=2))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     if "--residual-accuracy" in sys.argv:
         _run_residual_accuracy_check()
